STOP (SAFE-049, simulated only). The request is one unitree_go/msg/LowCmd on /mujoco/lowcmd, timeout_ms 1000, matching init_cmd: twenty motor_cmd slots, mode 0x01, q PosStopF (2.146e9), dq VelStopF (16000), kp, kd and tau 0 (low_level_ctrl.cpp:71-78; PosStopF and VelStopF at src/deploy_rl_policy/include/common/motor_crc.h:18-19). The simulator subscription is mujoco_simulator.py:24. pd_control is (target_q - q) * kp - dq * kd (mujoco_simulator.py:112-114), so kp and kd at zero make that torque zero. While low_level_ctrl runs, its 5 ms timer (low_level_ctrl.cpp:63) republishes a keep-branch LowCmd with nonzero kp and kd (low_level_ctrl.cpp:148-167) on the publisher created at low_level_ctrl.cpp:47 (/mujoco/lowcmd when is_simulation is true). The confirmation subscribes to /mujoco/lowcmd after the request and refuses a later LowCmd with nonzero kp or kd on motor_cmd[0..11], including a stationary hold at kp 50 and kd 1 whose joint velocity and base position stay inside the bounds. The torque being about zero when the pose is already at the target is not a confirmation. The citation for those fields is low_level_ctrl.cpp:160-167. The package binds only /mujoco topics.

SOURCES. The lowstate fill does not assign a stamp (mujoco_simulator.py:92-98) and /mujoco/pos is a Float32MultiArray (:99-101). Both publishers are volatile. /mujoco/lowstate and /mujoco/pos are create_publisher(..., 10) at mujoco_simulator.py:20-21, freshness arrival, min_interval_ms 1, history durability volatile cited at those lines. Joint velocity is motor_state[i].dq filled at mujoco_simulator.py:95. Base position is data from qpos[:19] at mujoco_simulator.py:100. Predicate: motor_state.0.dq through motor_state.11.dq as abs_max joint_dq_0..11 (rad/s), plus span_max on data.0, data.1 and data.2 (base_x, base_y, base_z, m). Every threshold is Limit.operator_required. consecutive 3, min_span_ms 4, max_gap_ms 500, confirm_within_ms 1500, estop_latency_ms 2500. fixtures/estop-confirmation.json holds fake placeholders only. The sensor timer is 0.002 s (mujoco_simulator.py:33). Three counted samples span 4 ms, which equals min_span_ms, so do not raise that bound. The 1 ms timer at mujoco_simulator.py:34 is update_tau and does not publish these topics. A slower stream still meets the arrival window while the gap stays under max_gap_ms 500. A stream faster than min_interval_ms 1 restarts the arrival count. A replay spaced at or above that interval is not distinguished from live samples.

RISK is R2. The card floor was R0. low_level_ctrl publishes the same LowCmd shape on /lowcmd when is_simulation is false (low_level_ctrl.cpp:52-54). This package does not bind /lowcmd. The actuating q, kp and kd leaves are Limit.operator_required. The clone states no bound, and none was invented. site-limits.example.json is an example overlay, not a device limit. Without a site limits file an invoke is rejected LIMITS_UNSET and sends nothing. With the example overlay the unconfirmed stop latches before the envelope probes, so G8 fails: TSAFE-001 is RESET_REFUSED, SAFE-028 reports safe_state_achieved false, and the SAFE-014 probes return ESTOP_ENGAGED. The capability input stays twelve entries of q, kp and kd.
